zh: 从某个节点出发向下的路径，要么只有它自己，要么接上恰好一个孩子出发的向下路径；路径不能在一个节点处同时伸向两棵子树。
设 best[u] 为从 u 出发向下的最大路径和，则 best[u] = value[u] + max(0, 各孩子的 best)。孩子的结果要先算好，答案是所有 best[u] 的最大值；全为负数时它就是最大的单个节点值。
先由 parent 数组建孩子列表（父下标不一定小于子下标），从根 0 做 BFS 得到父先于子的顺序，再逆序计算 best；不要用递归，深链可达 10^5 层。
en: A downward path starting at a node either is just that node or continues into exactly one child's downward path; it can never branch into two subtrees at a node.

Let best[u] be the maximum sum of a downward path starting at u; then best[u] = value[u] + max(0, best of each child). Children must be computed first, and the answer is the maximum best[u]; when everything is negative it is simply the largest single value.

Build child lists from the parent array (a parent index is not guaranteed to be smaller than its child), run BFS from root 0 to get an order where parents come before children, then compute best in reverse order. Avoid recursion: a chain can be 10^5 deep.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Traverse iteratively to get an order in which parents come before children, then process it in reverse to compute each node's best downward sum: its own value plus the largest positive child path; the answer is the maximum over all nodes.

## Proof of correctness

A valid path starting at u either contains only u or continues into the downward path of exactly one child, so the recurrence enumerates every possibility. The post-order guarantees that the children's results are already correct, so by induction we get the optimum for every start, and taking the maximum gives the global optimum over non-empty paths; when all values are negative it still returns the largest single node value.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space; no recursion is used, which avoids overflow on deep chains.
